newsitem.title: USA: Fox Kids gains Int'l Family stake.
newsitem.headline: Fox Kids gains Int'l Family stake.

text.p: Fox Kids Worldwide Inc has acquired a majority of the voting power of International Family Entertainment Inc as part of the $1.9 billion merger between the companies, they said on Friday.

Fox Kids completed agreements to acquire a total of 15.6 million International Family class B common shares at $35 each from International Family Chairman Pat Robertson, Timothy Robertson and other family members, the Christian Broadcasting Network Inc, and Regent University for $35 .

Liberty Media Corp received a new series of preferred stock in Fox Kids in exchange for its holdings that were equivalent to 9.7 million shares of International Family class B common stock, International Family and Fox Kids said in a joint statement.
Fox Kids is a venture between News Corp Ltd and Haim Saban.
International Family will be the surviving company after the acquisition and all shareholders of International Family other than Fox Kids will receive $35 a share in the merger.
International Family shares on Friday closed at 34-1/2, up 1/8.
